verdict.rationale: Pinecone's own marketing says you can manage indexes from the console 'or stay in the terminal', which hints at first-party terminal tooling, but nothing names or documents an official CLI. The 'claude plugin install pinecone' command runs inside Claude Code's plugin system, and the Claude Code/Gemini CLI mentions refer to third-party CLIs, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official Pinecone CLI, CLI install and command documentation, AI-native/agentic CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
